text.title: OptionCode
text.description: Recovery option code, for example ATLAS-EXPEDITE-B.

text_1.title: AsOfDate
text_1.description: Explicit scenario date YYYY-MM-DD used to check option validity.

inputs.name: OptEval
inputs.value: @if(empty(outputs('List_option')?['body/value']), 'NotFound', if(not(and(equals(length(trim(coalesce(triggerBody()?['text_1'], ''))), 10), equals(substring(concat(trim(coalesce(triggerBody()?['text_1'], '')), '__________'), 4, 1), '-'), equals(substring(concat(trim(coalesce(triggerBody()?['text_1'], '')), '__________'), 7, 1), '-'))), 'InvalidDate', if(and(not(equals(outputs('Option')?['cr458_asofdate'], null)), less(trim(coalesce(triggerBody()?['text_1'], '')), outputs('Option')?['cr458_asofdate'])), concat('NotYetQuoted: quoted from ', string(outputs('Option')?['cr458_asofdate'])), if(and(not(equals(outputs('Option')?['cr458_validuntil'], null)), greater(trim(coalesce(triggerBody()?['text_1'], '')), outputs('Option')?['cr458_validuntil'])), 'Expired', if(not(equals(outputs('Option')?['cr458_availabilitystatus'], 'Confirmed')), concat('NotSelectable: ', coalesce(outputs('Option')?['cr458_availabilitystatus'], 'unknown availability')), if(equals(outputs('Option')?['cr458_arrivaldate'], null), 'NoDocumentedArrival', 'Selectable'))))))

inputs.name: Message
inputs.value: @concat('Requested baseline version ', string(triggerBody()?['number']), ' does not match current version ', string(outputs('Project')?['cr458_baselineversion']), '.')

inputs.name: Message
inputs.value: @concat('Proposed finish ', if(equals(variables('OptEval'), 'Selectable'), coalesce(outputs('Option')?['cr458_arrivaldate'], ''), ''), ' is not an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Relative dates are not interpreted.')

inputs.name: Message
inputs.value: @concat('Proposed finish ', if(equals(variables('OptEval'), 'Selectable'), coalesce(outputs('Option')?['cr458_arrivaldate'], ''), ''), ' is outside calendar ', outputs('Project')?['cr458_calendarcode'], '. The tool does not extrapolate.')

inputs.name: Message
inputs.value: @concat('The next working day after ', if(equals(variables('OptEval'), 'Selectable'), coalesce(outputs('Option')?['cr458_arrivaldate'], ''), ''), ' is outside the seeded calendar.')

inputs.name: Assumptions
inputs.value: @concat('Proposed finish ', if(equals(variables('OptEval'), 'Selectable'), coalesce(outputs('Option')?['cr458_arrivaldate'], ''), ''), ' falls on a non-working day; earliest effective completion is ', outputs('IdxDate')?[string(variables('EffectiveIdx'))], '.')

inputs.name: Assumptions
inputs.value: @concat('Calendar ', outputs('Project')?['cr458_calendarcode'], ': Monday to Friday working days. No public holidays configured.')

inputs.name: Message
inputs.value: @concat('The dependency graph for ', toUpper(coalesce(outputs('Option')?['cr458_Project']?['cr458_projectcode'], '')), ' contains a cycle. Assessment refused.')

inputs.name: Unknowns
inputs.value: @if(equals(items('Loop_milestones')?['cr458_durationdays'], null), concat('Finish for ', items('Loop_milestones')?['cr458_milestonecode'], ' cannot be computed: its duration is not documented.'), concat('A predecessor of ', items('Loop_milestones')?['cr458_milestonecode'], ' has no computable finish; its finish date cannot be computed.'))

inputs.select: @concat('| ', item()?['code'], ' ', item()?['name'], ' | ', item()?['owner'], ' | ', item()?['baselineFinish'], ' | ', coalesce(item()?['computedFinish'], 'unknown'), ' | ', if(equals(item()?['slipWorkingDays'], null), 'unknown', string(item()?['slipWorkingDays'])), ' | ', item()?['verdict'], ' |')

Impact_table.inputs: @concat('| Milestone | Owner | Baseline finish | Computed finish | Slip (working days) | Verdict |', decodeUriComponent('%0A'), '|---|---|---|---|---|---|', decodeUriComponent('%0A'), '| ', outputs('Changed_row')?['code'], ' ', outputs('Changed_row')?['name'], ' | ', outputs('Changed_row')?['owner'], ' | ', outputs('Changed_row')?['baselineFinish'], ' | ', outputs('Changed_row')?['computedFinish'], ' | ', string(outputs('Changed_row')?['slipWorkingDays']), ' | Changed (proposed ', outputs('Changed_row')?['proposedFinish'], ') |', if(empty(body('Select_table_rows')), '', concat(decodeUriComponent('%0A'), join(body('Select_table_rows'), decodeUriComponent('%0A')))))

inputs.source: Computed by the AssessChange flow from Dataverse records; not generated by the language model.

body.message: @if(equals(variables('OptEval'), 'Selectable'), if(equals(variables('Status'), 'Assessed'), '', variables('Message')), concat('Option ', toUpper(trim(coalesce(triggerBody()?['text'], ''))), ' was not simulated: ', variables('OptEval'), '.'))

status.title: Status
status.description: Assessed when simulated; otherwise the option evaluation or an engine status.

message.title: Message
message.description: Reason when Status is not Assessed.

assessmentjson.title: AssessmentJson
assessmentjson.description: Full structured assessment. Quote from it; do not recompute.

unaffectedcodescsv.description: Milestones not reachable from the change.

optionevaluation.description: Selectable, Expired, NotSelectable: ..., NoDocumentedArrival, NotFound or InvalidDate.
